_about: Hand-written e-mails NOT taken from data/samples (new wording) - a check beyond the samples, because the M03 keyword lists were written while looking at the samples. expected: REMITTANCE | PTP | MIXED | OUT_OF_SCOPE:<CATEGORY>. History (be honest when quoting the results): batch 1 (U01-U26) first run 23/26 rules + model, its misses led to two general fixes; batch 2 (U27-U44) written afterwards, first run rules only 8/18, rules + model 15/18, then its missed phrases were added to the keyword lists. Both batches are therefore no longer truly unseen: add a new batch before quoting a fresh number.
